title: Toe last shoe on machine
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a toe-lasting machine
masks_caveat: from about 7.2 s another worker's hand appears at the top of the image; it is not outlined, and neither is the wearer's right hand there.
contact_roles: both hands hold the shoe sole-up in the machine through the press, then put it on the conveyor beside its pair. In the last second "shoe" in the contact also means the pair's other shoe (squared up at 7.8–8.0 s) and then another shoe the left hand picks up; only the worked shoe is outlined. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (those frames are marked as reviewer-corrected in the data).
depth_caveat: the error here is about twice the other clips': much of the view is the toe-lasting machine right in front of the camera (dark, shiny metal), and the worker turns away to the conveyor, so there are fewer steady points to check and align the depth against.
